attributes.name: Snick
attributes.powers:
At the start of your turn, reveal this card to recharge the ally Grogul or the ally Torius Vin from your discard pile.

Recharge this card to add 1d6 and the Swashbuckling trait to your Disable check or your check to acquire.

Discard this card to explore your location.
